prompt:
High-fidelity product UI comp, portrait 440x960 Chrome extension side panel, no phone or browser frame. Product: CueWave, a YouTube semantic probe tool. This is the honest category-standard option, executed with excellent craft: familiar Chrome productivity extension, neutral light interface, fast and accessible. Palette white #FFFFFF, ink #17212B, primary blue #2563EB, divider #E5EAF0, restrained semantic accents. Chinese UI.

Structure: compact CueWave header and connected status; current video title "为什么我们会被算法影响？ · 18:42"; prominent but conventional input labeled "添加语义探针" with placeholder "输入你想寻找的内容…" and Add button; preset suggestion chips "知识科普", "幽默程度", "推广信息"; active probes listed compactly with visibility toggles and colors; clear primary "分析视频" button and subtitle-ready progress. Then a conventional horizontal multi-probe timeline with colored histogram bands and time ticks, selected probe obvious. Follow with "最高热点" rows at 04:18, 11:32, 16:05, each showing one Chinese evidence excerpt and a jump arrow. Advanced settings and saved videos collapsed at bottom. Use standard form controls, modest corner radius, clean spacing, clear focus and status hierarchy. Make the task obvious and implementable. No marketing hero, no device mockup, no photos, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no giant cards, no invented metrics or commercial claims.
